decide.title: Your decision
decide.approveBody: It takes effect at once, in the same step as your approval, and is recorded with your name.
decide.approveMarginBody: It approves the version’s margin and is recorded with your name. Nothing is sent yet: the salesperson, not you, then issues and sends the version.
decide.rejectBody: Nothing takes effect. The person who asked is told, with your reason.
decide.reasonHint: Shown to the person who asked, and kept in the audit log
decide.reasonRequired: Give a reason for rejecting it.
decide.yours: You asked for this, so you cannot decide it
decide.yoursBody: Someone else with the approving permission must approve or reject it. You can withdraw it while it is waiting.
decide.cannot: Your role cannot decide this kind of request
decide.cannotBody: Someone holding the approving permission for it at this branch decides it.
decide.withdrawBody: It will not be decided, and anything waiting on it is undone.
